expires_at.description: When it stops, within a year (SEC-07).

networks.description: The networks it may call from, as CIDR prefixes; none: anywhere. Give them where you can (SEC-07).

items.description: A network, as a CIDR prefix.

owner_id.description: The member it acts for; you when left out. It never does more than this member may do now.

public_key.description: The public half of the key its private_key_jwt assertions are signed with, as a JWK (RFC 7517): an EC P-256 key (ES256) or an RSA key of 2048 bits or more (RS256). Never send the private key.

reads_per_minute.description: Its own limit of reads a minute, at most the platform's 600; none: the platform's.

scopes.description: Its narrow scopes, only what it needs: fyniq.read.<area> (reports, sales, purchases, banking, accounting, planning, compliance) or fyniq.write.<area> (sales, purchases, banking, accounting).

items.description: A narrow scope: fyniq.read.<area> or fyniq.write.<area>.

writes_per_minute.description: Its own limit of writes a minute, at most the platform's 120; none: the platform's.
